Customer Lifetime Value Forecasting and Behavioral Segmentation using Pandas, K-Means, and Survival Regression Models

Unique Reference: ai-ml-ds-F98ZkLvxRqm
Filename: customer_lifetime_value_forecasting.py

This project forecasts the Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) and segments customer behaviors using:

  • Pandas for data wrangling,
  • K-Means for clustering,
  • Lifetimes & scikit-survival for CLV and survival analysis,
  • Dask + PyArrow (extendable) for parallel/distributed analytics.
# Project Title: Customer Lifetime Value Forecasting and Behavioral Segmentation using Pandas, K-Means, and Survival Regression Models
# Unique Reference: ai-ml-ds-F98ZkLvxRqm
# File Name: customer_lifetime_value_forecasting.py

# ----------- BEGIN CODE -----------

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import dask.dataframe as dd
import pyarrow as pa
import pyarrow.parquet as pq
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sksurv.linear_model import CoxPHSurvivalAnalysis  # pip install scikit-survival
from sksurv.util import Surv
from lifetimes import BetaGeoFitter, GammaGammaFitter
from typing import Tuple, List, Dict, Any
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Constants
data_url: str = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/selva86/datasets/master/OnlineRetail.csv"

# Load Data
raw_data: pd.DataFrame = pd.read_csv(data_url, encoding='ISO-8859-1')

# Data Cleaning
def clean_data(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = df.dropna()
    df = df[~df['InvoiceNo'].astype(str).str.startswith('C')]
    df = df[df['Quantity'] > 0]
    df = df[df['UnitPrice'] > 0]
    return df

# Feature Engineering
def generate_features(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df['InvoiceDate'] = pd.to_datetime(df['InvoiceDate'])
    df['TotalSum'] = df['Quantity'] * df['UnitPrice']
    snapshot_date: pd.Timestamp = df['InvoiceDate'].max() + pd.Timedelta(days=1)
    customers: pd.DataFrame = df.groupby('CustomerID').agg({
        'InvoiceDate': [lambda x: (snapshot_date - x.max()).days,
                        lambda x: (x.max() - x.min()).days,
                        'count'],
        'InvoiceNo': 'nunique',
        'TotalSum': ['sum', 'mean']
    })
    customers.columns = ['Recency', 'Customer_Age', 'Frequency', 'Unique_Invoices', 'Monetary_Sum', 'Monetary_Avg']
    customers = customers[customers['Monetary_Sum'] > 0]
    return customers.reset_index()

# Clustering Behavior
def perform_clustering(data: pd.DataFrame) -> Tuple[pd.DataFrame, KMeans]:
    X: np.ndarray = StandardScaler().fit_transform(data[['Recency', 'Frequency', 'Monetary_Sum']])
    kmeans: KMeans = KMeans(n_clusters=5, random_state=42)
    labels: np.ndarray = kmeans.fit_predict(X)
    data['Segment'] = labels
    return data, kmeans

# Survival Dataset Conversion
def prepare_survival_dataset(data: pd.DataFrame) -> Tuple[pd.DataFrame, np.ndarray]:
    data['event_observed'] = np.where(data['Recency'] < data['Customer_Age'], 1, 0)
    structured_array = Surv.from_arrays(event=data['event_observed'] == 1, time=data['Customer_Age'])
    return data, structured_array

# Survival Regression
def perform_survival_regression(X: pd.DataFrame, y: np.ndarray) -> CoxPHSurvivalAnalysis:
    X_model = X[['Recency', 'Frequency', 'Monetary_Sum']]
    model = CoxPHSurvivalAnalysis()
    model.fit(X_model, y)
    return model

# CLV Forecasting

def forecast_clv(df: pd.DataFrame) -> Tuple[BetaGeoFitter, GammaGammaFitter]:
    df_clv = df[['CustomerID', 'Frequency', 'Recency', 'Customer_Age', 'Monetary_Avg']]
    df_clv.columns = ['customer_id', 'frequency', 'recency', 'T', 'monetary_value']
    bgf = BetaGeoFitter(penalizer_coef=0.001)
    ggf = GammaGammaFitter(penalizer_coef=0.01)
    bgf.fit(df_clv['frequency'], df_clv['recency'], df_clv['T'])
    ggf.fit(df_clv['frequency'], df_clv['monetary_value'])
    return bgf, ggf

# Example Inference Pipeline
def run_pipeline() -> None:
    df_clean: pd.DataFrame = clean_data(raw_data)
    df_feat: pd.DataFrame = generate_features(df_clean)
    df_seg, _ = perform_clustering(df_feat)
    df_surv, surv_y = prepare_survival_dataset(df_seg)
    surv_model = perform_survival_regression(df_surv, surv_y)
    bgf_model, ggf_model = forecast_clv(df_seg)

    clv: pd.Series = ggf_model.customer_lifetime_value(bgf_model,
                                                       df_seg['Frequency'],
                                                       df_seg['Recency'],
                                                       df_seg['Customer_Age'],
                                                       df_seg['Monetary_Avg'],
                                                       time=6,
                                                       freq='D',
                                                       discount_rate=0.01)
    df_seg['CLV'] = clv
    print(df_seg[['CustomerID', 'Segment', 'CLV']].head(10))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_pipeline()

# ----------- END CODE -----------
